<thought>Based on the observed protonated ion at m/z ≈ 199.0, the neutral molecular mass is about 198 Da. A plausible monoisotopic composition that matches this mass is C₉H₁₀O₅ (exact mass ≈ 198.053 Da, within typical experimental error for a single‑charge ESI measurement). No other heteroatoms are required to explain the spectrum.</thought>
<final_answer>C9H10O5</final_answer>
